FCDO  advises against all but essential travel to:
within 5km of the Mexican border from the Pacific Coast up to and including the Gracias a Dios crossing
to the towns of Santa Ana Huista, San Antonio Huista and La Democracia in the department of Huehuetenango
Find out more about  why FCDO advises against travel to these areas .
State of Emergency
The Guatemalan government has declared a 30-day state of emergency in the departments of Zacapa and Izabal. Restrictions on movement, public gatherings and demonstrations may be imposed. Follow the instructions of local authorities and refer to official Guatemalan government sources for details of any restrictions in place.
